Sentence: The injury-plagued Indianapolis Colts lost another quarterback on Thursday but last year's AFC finalists rallied together to shoot down the Philadelphia Eagles 37-10 in a showdown of playoff contenders. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Justin suffered a sprained right shoulder in the third quarter and did not return. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Poland said on Friday that Swiss bank accounts, which in many cases belonged to Polish Jews who died in the Holocaust, were used in debt settlements between the two countries after the World War Two. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Foreign Minister Dariusz Rosati, unveiling first findings of a special government commission, said that in 1970s the then communist Poland received 460,000 Swiss francs from the accounts. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: "In 1970s, Poland received from unclaimed accounts in Switzerland a sum of 460,000 francs. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: What was its right (to the money) ...I do not know, "Rosati told a news conference. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Switzerland stands accused by Senator Alfonse D'Amato, chairman of the powerful U.S. Senate Banking Committee, of agreeing to give money to Poland from unclaimed bank accounts of Polish citizens, as part of an accord on compensating Swiss nationals whose assets had been seized in communist Poland. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Many of these citizens were Jews murdered during the war, when Nazi German invaders killed most of Poland's 3.5 million Jews. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Rosati did not say whether the payment in 1970s was part of the 1949 agreement between Warsaw and Switzerland on compensation to Swiss citizens whose assets were seized by the Soviet-imposed communists authorities after World War Two. Sentence: "I expect that the commission will finish gathering information within two to three weeks and then more details will be provided," Rosati said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Rosati confirmed that the 1949 agreement had provided for granting Switzerland about 53 million francs and most of this sum was repaid with coal exports. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: He said, however, that Switzerland did get about 16,000 francs from the so-called "dead accounts" as part of the compensation. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: "About 16,000 francs were seized from accounts of four or five Polish citizens, whose data we do not precisely know. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: The issue is of moral and legal nature, because its financial significance is small, "Rosati said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Government disperses protest with water cannons. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: RANGOON 1996-12-07 List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Burmese troops and riot police moved in to disperse a student street protest at a suburban road junction near the Ranyon (Rangoon) University early on Saturday, witnesses said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: They said police and troops used water cannons from fire engines to subdue about 120 university students sitting in at the centre of the junction at about 3 a.m. before they moved in to round them up. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: The students, who had staged an 11-hour protest at the junction in northern Rangoon, were taken away in three vehicles. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: The witnesses said some of the students were hit with batons while they were herded onto the vehicles and it was believed they were taken to the Insein prison in suburban Rangoon. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: The protesting students, mostly from Rangoon University, were demanding the right to organise independent unions on campuses and the release of about 80 student leaders currently in jail. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: They were among 500 students who started demonstrating at the intersection on late Friday afternoon. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: The protest was the second major one in five days in the capital. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Burmese students march briefly out of campus. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Vithoon Amorn List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: RANGOON 1996-12-06 List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: About 200 Burmese students marched briefly from troubled Yangon Institute of Technology in northern Rangoon on Friday towards the University of Yangon six km (four miles) away, and returned to their campus, witnesses said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Seven truckloads of armed riot police and three fire engines were on standby at one of the junctions near the institute. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: There were no clashes. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: "They are now back in the YIT campus," an institute official who declined to be identified told Reuters by telephone. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: One of two roads leading to the University of Yangon from the institute had been closed by authorities. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: But about 300 university students were still gathered outside the gates of their campus, witnesses said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: They were singing peacefully. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: On Monday and Tuesday, students from the institute and the university launched protests against what they said was unfair handling by police of a brawl between some of their colleagues and restaurant owners in October. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: On Tuesday and Wednesday, opposition leader Aung San Suu Kyi was restricted to her home by the military government to prevent her from being drawn into the protests. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: She was allowed to move freely on Thursday. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: The protest culminated at dawn on Tuesday with several hundred students being detained briefly by police in central Rangoon. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: The street protests were the biggest seen in the capital since the student-led pro-democracry demonstrations of September 1988 when the junta crushed the uprising. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Thousands were killed or imprisoned. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Earlier on Friday some of the students, who were held briefly by police during the protests earlier this week, said they were still dissatisfied with the military government. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: They told Reuters they were unhappy that the ruling State Law and Order Restoration Council (SLORC) had not heeded their calls for the right to organise independent unions on campus. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: "We still want government answers to our demands. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: We want police punishment to be published in newspapers, "one student said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: But the students stressed their protests were non-political and they had no contact with Suu Kyi's National League for Democracy (NLD). List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Suu Kyi, a Nobel laureate and daughter of independence hero Aung San, and key NLD officials have also denied any link with the students. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: But they have said both parties had a "moral link" in that they were against police brutality and injustice. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: The students also demanded the government announce punishments meted out to policemen who they said had manhandled students involved in a brawl with some restaurant owners near the Yangon institute in October. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: The students appealed to the government not to close the institute because of their latest demonstration. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: The institute was shut for nearly two years after the 1988 uprising. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: On Friday, the road leading to Suu Kyi's lakeside residence in central Rangoon remained closed by police. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Union leaders outraged by WTO snub to ILO head. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: SINGAPORE 1996-12-06 List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: International trade union leaders on Friday expressed outrage that the head of the International Labour Organisation (ILO) had been barred from speaking at next week's WTO meeting in Singapore. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Bill Jordan, general secretary of the International Confederation of Free Trade Unions (ICFTU), told a news conference the withdrawal of a WTO invitation to ILO director general Michel Hansenne was "outrageous behaviour on the part of an organisation that wants to command respect in the world". List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

input_text: Sentence: Jordan said a small group of developing nations that oppose linking trade talks and labour conditions had pressured World Trade Organisation (WTO) officials to prevent Hansenne from taking the platform to urge such links. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: "It is to their shame that those who are responsible for encouraging this meeting responded (to the pressure) in silencing him," Jordan said after the opening of an ICFTU conference on international labour standards and trade. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: The three-day trade union conference in Singapore hopes to push labour issues onto the WTO agenda. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Jordan said the WTO's credibility was at stake over the issue of trade and labour. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: The ICFTU said it wanted the WTO conference beginning on Monday to outlaw forced and child labour, end discrimination in hiring, and guarantee the right to join a union. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Bill Brett, chairman of the ILO Workers Group, told Reuters before the news conference he was "not too surprised, but very disappointed" that the speaking invitation had been withdrawn. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: "Some governments are very determined to stop the issue (of trade and labour rights) being discussed," he said, adding that the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) seemed particularly hostile to the ILO agenda. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: ASEAN groups Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: The ILO wants a trade and labour rights "social clause" included in the final ministerial statement issued by WTO leaders at the end of the meeting, the organization's first ministerial-level gathering. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Speaking to ICFTU delegates, Richard Eglin, director of the WTO secretariat, said the WTO was capable of making a significant contribution to governmental efforts to solve social problems. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: But he said the WTO's organisational structure made it difficult to impose on its members a social clause such as that called for by the ILO. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Indian rubber demand seen outstripping production. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: SINGAPORE 1996-12-06 List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Indian rubber demand is seen outpacing local production in the 1996/97 April / March season and the trend will persist way into the next century, the chairman of the Rubber Board of India said on Friday. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: K.J. Matthew said at the Asia Rubber Markets meeting here Indian production of natural rubber in 1996/97 will reach 547,000 tonnes against projected demand of 578,000 tonnes, a gap of 31,000 tonnes. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: For synthetic rubber, production reached 68,200 tonnes in 1995/96 while consumption in the same season hit 134,085 tonnes, Matthew added. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: "Though schemes designed to realise further increases in the production of natural rubber are being operated successfully, the demand-supply gap is expected to widen," he said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Indian synthetic rubber output is not expected to rise significantly in the next season but demand will rise to 145,000 tonnes. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Matthew estimates that by the 2000/01 season, the gap between natural rubber output and consumption will rise to 51,000 tonnes and 319,000 tonnes in 2010/11. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Natural rubber production will go up to 695,000 tonnes in 2000/01 against consumption of 746,000 tonnes. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: In 2010/11, domestic demand should rise further to 1.233 million tonnes while production will only reach about 914,000 tonnes. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: One way to bridge the widening gap is to put more land under cultivation which the Rubber Board official estimates will reach 220,000 hectares between now and the year 2003 although Matthew said this may not be possible at this time in India. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: "The development objective for the rubber plantation industry will be to increase production to the best extent possibly with a view to minimising imports of natural rubber," he said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Japan's authorities seen seeking to rein in dollar. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: George Nishiyama List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: TOKYO 1996-12-06 List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Comments by Japan's tight-lipped central bank chief and an influential top bureaucrat are further signs that the nation's authorities want to keep the dollar at current levels, market sources said on Friday. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: In a rare expression of a view on currencies by the Bank of Japan (BOJ) governor, Yasuo Matsushita was quoted in Japan's leading economic daily on Friday as saying that he sees no further, immediate fall in the yen. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: This followed a widely watched television appearance late on Thursday by Eisuke Sakakibara, a high-ranking Finance Ministry official, who denied he had said he wants to guide the dollar lower to between 108 and 110 yen. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: But many in the market thought Sakakibara's real intentions lay elsewhere, and took more notice of his comments about the U.S. government's stance on the dollar, dealers said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: "I think his views on (U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert) Rubin's comments were indeed what he himself thinks about the dollar," said Hank Note, chief dealer at Sumitomo Bank. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Asked about Rubin's comment that a strong dollar was in U.S. interests, Sakakibara said the remark does not necessarily mean the United States supports a stronger dollar. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: "It's a strong dollar, not stronger. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: In that sense, the comments are not pointing to a certain direction, "he said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: "It shows that Sakakibara is not for a stronger dollar either," said Sumitomo's Note. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Takao Sakoh, first vice president at Union Bank of Switzerland in Tokyo, said: "Maybe a dollar at 104.50 yen is not acceptable (to Sakakibara), but it may be okay at the current level, at the lower end of 112 yen." List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Market participants have kept a close eye on Sakakibara, chief of the ministry's International Finance Bureau, as a comment he made in November after the dollar hit this year's high of 114.92 yen pushed the currency down sharply. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: He had said then that the market's view on Japan's economy was too pessimistic and that he believed it was stronger than the market thought. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Dealers have come to refer to 115 yen as the "Sakakibara ceiling" for the dollar following the remark. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Adding to the comments by "Mr Yen", as Sakakibara is known for his prominence in the currency market, was BOJ governor Matsushita's remark. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: "The recent level of the yen exchange rate has been stable, and it does not appear to be moving towards a further depreciation of the yen immediately, so import prices are likely to stabilise at current levels," Matsushita said in an interview with the Nihon Keizai Shimbun. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: "The fact that he touched on the issue of inflation triggered by import prices shows that the BOJ does not want a further depreciation of the yen, past 115 yen," said Yasuhito Kawashima, chief forex manager at Toyo Trust & Banking Co. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Some said the central bank may have been concerned a weaker yen would lead to unfounded pessimism about Japan's economy. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: "There was concern that foreign investors may sell Japanese stocks if the dollar goes above 115 yen. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: The BOJ does not want the yen's weakness to lead to pessimism over the economy, "said Taisuke Tanaka, market strategist with Credit Suisse in Tokyo. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Senior BOJ officials have separately said financial markets' views on the economy have been too negative. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: "I realise there are negative views in the markets about the impact of the consumption tax hike and drop in public spending, but the markets appear to be exaggerating the magnitude of the negative impact," a senior BOJ official told Reuters on Friday. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: The consumption tax is due to raised in April from three to five percent. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Lebanon sentences pro-Israeli warlord to death. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Haitham Haddadin List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: BEIRUT 1996-12-06 List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: A Lebanese military court on Friday sentenced to death in absentia the commander of Israel's surrogate militia in south Lebanon on treason charges. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: The court convicted General Antoine Lahd, head of the South Lebanon Army (SLA), of collaborating with Israel with which Lebanon is officially at war. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Lahd, a 69-year-old former Lebanese army major-general, heads the 3,000-strong SLA militia which helps Israel hold a border zone in south Lebanon to ward off cross-frontier guerrilla raids on northern Israel. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Lahd said a few days after the trial began on February 16 that Lebanese authorities must drop the charges or risk blocking any peace deal with the Jewish state. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: He said Israel was capable of pressuring Lebanon's Syrian-backed government to stop the legal pursuit. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: The charges against Lahd were: forming a hostile army, carrying weapons on Israel's side, helping Israel strip off a part of Lebanese territory by violence, forming an armed gang, killing or trying to kill Lebanese civilians by artillery shelling and kidnapping Lebanese citizens for long periods. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Shortly before Lahd's trial began, a Beirut military prosecutor charged another 89 former Lebanese army soldiers with collaborating with Israel. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: No date has been set for the trial of the men, all members of the SLA living in the Israeli-held zone in south Lebanon. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Israel and Lahd have repeatedly demanded safety guarantees for the SLA -- a mixed Christian-Shi'ite Moslem force -- which the Jewish states regards as loyal allies. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Israel has said the Lebanese army must incorporate the SLA fighters into its ranks as an army brigade as a condition for peace. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: But Lebanese political analysts have said that would be out of the question and Lebanese authorities pre-empted the issue by taking legal action against Lahd. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Former Israeli Prime Minister Shimon Peres, calling Lahd "a great Lebanese patriot", said earlier this year Lebanon had insulted the SLA commander by ordering his arrest on the treason charges. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Peres, who was ousted in May by rightwing Israeli leader Benjamin Netanyahu, said there could not be real negotiations with Lebanon "unless it will stop the maltreatment of the SLA and its commanders." List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: The Beirut military court also sentenced to life in jail in absentia Etian Saqr, former head of the pro-Israeli Guardians of the Cedars, a small rightwing Christian civil war militia. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Saqr, whose trial was concurrent with Lahd's, was convicted of "contacting the Israeli enemy, passing information to Israel and undertaking hostile acts against Lebanon". List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: 14 years later, Florida man dies for killing. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: TALLAHASSEE, Fla. 1996-12-06 List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Fourteen years after he bludgeoned and shot a man whose trailer home he robbed in 1982, John Mills Jr. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: , 41, was put to death in Florida's electric chair Friday. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: As Glenn Lawhon, a rural Florida minister who is the victim's father, looked on, Mills was pronounced dead at 7:13 a.m. EST (1213 GMT) for the murder of Lester Lawhon. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Speaking in Arabic, Mills made a final statement before an anonymous citizen flipped the switch that sent 2000 volts of electricity through his body, said Department of Corrections spokesman Eugene Morris, who was present at the execution. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: "I bear witness that there is no God but Allah and I bear witness that the prophet Mohammed is the messenger of God," he quoted Mills as saying. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Prison officials said they had no record of Mills' official conversion, but they said that, on May 14, 1991, he had asked that a new name, Yuhanna Abdullah Muhammed, be added to his prison file, which is usually an indication of a conversion to Islam. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Mills is the 38th person to die in Florida's electric chair since the U.S. Supreme Court reversed itself in 1976 and legalised the death penalty. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Prison officials said Mills made no special request for a last meal and did not eat the steak, fried potatoes and orange juice offered him. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: He spent Thursday with family members and his spiritual adviser, Morris said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Mills was scheduled to die Wednesday but had his sentence temporarily postponed by the Florida Supreme Court. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: On Thursday, the 11th Circuit U.S. Court of Appeals in Atlanta denied his appeal in federal court. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: In March 1982, Mills and accomplice Michael Frederick knocked on the door of Lester Lawhon's trailer in an attempt to rob it, police said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Lester Lawhon was taken to a nearby airstrip where he was bludgeoned with a tire iron. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Mills then fired two shots that killed Lawhon as the victim tried to run away. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Frederick is serving a 347-year sentence. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Bre-X, Barrick said to continue Busang talks. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: K.T. Arasu List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: JAKARTA 1996-12-06 List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Canada's Bre-X Minerals Ltd and Barrick Gold Corp are to continue negotiations to hammer out a partnership agreement to develop the spectacular Busang gold find in Indonesia, sources close to the talks said on Friday. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: "The negotiations will be held both in Toronto and in Jakarta," one source, speaking on condition of anonymity, told Reuters. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Another source said most of the key negotiators from both Bre-X and Barrick had returned to Toronto, but declined to say if there had been any progress in their negotiations. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Both sources said Bre-X and Barrick did not hold talks on Thursday with Mines and Energy Ministry Secretary-General Umar Said, who is coordinating the negotiations over the Busang find in East Kalimantan. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: The first source also said Bre-X had until December 21 to submit to the Indonesian Mines and Energy Ministry a feasibility study on the central region of the Busang property, estimated to contain 2.6 million ounces of gold. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: The richest parts of the property to the north and south of the central region have been estimated by Bre-X to contain 57 million ounces of gold. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: "Bre-X is expected to complete the feasibility report by December 16 and submit it to the government before the December 21 deadline," the source said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: He said Bre-X would then formally seek the permission of the Indonesian government to begin construction to develop Busang's central region, which might take up to two years. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: The source declined to say if there had been any progress in the talks between Bre-X and Barrick. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: "This is a huge project ... List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: we are not selling furniture, and Bre-X has 13,000 shareholders to answer to, "the source said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: "While there has been some agreement in principle on some issues, there are still others such as procedures and mechanisms that needed to be sorted out," he added. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: The source said no new deadline had been set by the Mines and Energy Ministry for Bre-X and Barrick to strike a deal. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: The Ministry had given the companies until December 4 to complete a partnership deal, and advised Bre-X to take a 25 percent stake and Barrick 75 percent to develop the property. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: "As far as I am aware, there's been no new deadline," the source said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: The Ministry's Umar said on Thursday that both Bre-X and Barrick had responded positively to a government letter recommending a 25-75 split in the Busang gold property. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: The government also wants 10 percent of the property. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Umar said the government had yet to receive a formal reply from the companies. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: He had said earlier that if the two companies failed to reach a partnership agreement, the government would explore other ways to expedite development of the Busang find. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Bre-X has a partnership deal with PT Panutan Duta of the Panutan Group run by President Suharto's eldest son, Sigit Harjojudanto, under which Panutan would receive $40 million over 40 months plus a 10 percent stake Busang's richest parts. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Barrick has teamed up with a construction company in the Citra Group of Suharto's eldest daughter, Siti Hardianti Rukmana, in what Barrick had said was a partnership "to prepare us for a potential mining development project". List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: FEATURE - Singapore sees prestige in hosting WTO. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Ramthan Hussain List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: SINGAPORE 1996-12-06 List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Singapore's winning campaign to host the World Trade Organisation (WTO)'s first ministerial meeting reflected its ambition to play a key role in shaping global free trade, the lifeblood of its economy, analysts said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: "As one of the world's most externally oriented economies, Singapore has a disproportionately large stake in the WTO," said Desmond Supple, economist at research house I.D.E.A. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: "Singapore stands to benefit more than most from continued global trade liberalisation as trade is the engine of its growth, accounting for nearly three times its gross domestic product." List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: The city-state met U.S. opposition two years ago in its bid to host the meeting, expected to gather 4,000 officials from 160 countries from December 9 to 13. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: In a stand some analysts linked to controversy over Singapore's caning of an American teenager for vandalism, then-U.S. Trade Representative Mickey Kantor had said the meeting ought to be held where the WTO was going to be headquartered. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: That would have meant Geneva. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: But Singapore had the support of other WTO members. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Derek da Cunha, senior fellow at the Institute of Policy Studies (ISEAS), said Singapore's hosting of the conference "carries a great deal of symbolism for the city-state, underscoring its commitment to free trade and its trading links across the globe." List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: There is the international prestige Singapore would enjoy, but "more importantly there is a genuine national interest in fostering better global free trade and an open market", said Tan Kong Yam, head of Business Policy at the National University of Singapore. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: At the ministerial meeting, trade ministers will review the work of the WTO and the implementation of the Uruguay Round free trade commitments under its predecessor the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT). List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: In June, the WTO hailed Singapore for its open market policies but the European Union and other trading powers called on Singapore to speed up the opening of its services sector. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Supple said the struggle that Singapore had to wage in vying to host the meeting would be repeated during the talks. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: "There is tension at every step of the way," since a battle line between the West and developing countries has been drawn over the issue of linking trade liberalisation with labour rights, he said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Supple said hosting the meeting carried prestige for Singapore, "however, this is quite intangible as the prestige factor may not necessarily lead to any additional investment and trade flows to this region." List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: From a commercial point of view, the meeting would be good for Singapore's tourism industry, Tan said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: A large part of Singapore's workforce would be mobilised to ensure the meeting would run without a glitch but the average Singaporean "would probably not be too concerned about some of the issues," Tan said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: "But the more educated public will realise that these kind of things are important for Singapore as a small economy." List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Supple said any political gains the Singapore government would get from the WTO meeting -- ahead of a general election due by April 1997 -- would depend on how successful it was in pushing its economic agenda. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: "If there are any movements toward freer trade, then Singapore's economy and the electorate would gain," he said. " List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: But I don't think it would be wise to play up the political aspect of this. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: I think political issues will take secondary importance to all these economic issues that will be displayed. " List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) said on Friday that it hopes to move into the international telecommunications business as soon as possible following the government's decision to split NTT into three firms under a holding company. Sentence: "We hope to start international telephone business as soon as possible," a company official told Reuters. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: The official said the latest government decision to split the company under a holding company would allow flexibility in NTT's international phone business. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Earlier, Posts and Telecommunications Minister Hisao Horinouchi told a news conference the government plans to split NTT into three firms under a holding company, but did not specify when the restructuring would likely take effect. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: One of the three new companies will be a long-distance operator and the other two will be local-call operators, Horinouchi said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: One of the local firms will operate in west Japan and the other in east Japan, he added. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: The long-distance operator will offer international services, Horinouchi said. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: The NTT official said the timing of the planned split-up was uncertain because more discussions by government officials were required. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Now aged 86, Woolmer senior lives with his son in Cape Town. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Woolmer's memories of Kanpur are few and blurred. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: "I don't remember much of the place," he said. " List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Former Australia test batsman Dean Jones hit an unbeaten 130 to lead Victoria's fightback in their Sheffield Shield match against Tasmania on Saturday. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Replying to the home side's first innings 481 for eight declared, Victoria reached 220 for three at close of play on the second day of the four-day match at Hobart's Bellerive Oval. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Jones became the fourth century-maker of the match, equalling the feats of Tasmanian trio David Boon, Shaun Young and Michael DiVenuto. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Jones, who took over as captain for the match in the absence of Australia test leg-spinner Shane Warne, added 195 runs for the third wicket with left-hander Laurie Harper. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Harper was eventually dismissed for 77 after the pair joined forces with their side reeling on nine for two. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Earlier, former Australia test batsman David Boon scored 118 and all-rounder Shaun Young hit 113. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: South Korea made virtually certain of an Asian Cup quarter-final spot with a 4-2 win over Indonesia in a Group A match on Saturday. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: After going four up in the first 55 minutes South Korea allowed Indonesia, newcomers to Asian Cup finals, back into the match, conceding two goals from rare counter attacks. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Kim Do Hoon opened the scoring for South Korea in only the fifth minute, turning unmarked on the penalty spot to fire a shot into the top corner. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: It looked like turning into a rout as Hwang Sun Hong rapidly added two more in the seventh and 15th minutes but although the Koreans continued to dominate they failed to add to the score before the interval. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: But they started the second half where they had left off and it was not long before they went four up, Ko Jeong Woon heading in from a free kick in the 55th minute. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: The Koreans then appeared to relax, allowing the Indonesians to get back into the match. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: Ronny Wabia scored for Indonesia three minutes later direct from a a corner kick that Korean goalkeeper Kim Byung reached with one hand but failed to keep out. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:

Sentence: With 65 minutes gone Indonesia's Widodo Putra, who scored a spectacular goal against Kuwait on Wednesday, was again on target, breaking through the Korean defence to beat the keeper with a low shot. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
Sentence: Indonesian keeper Hendro Kartiko produced a string of fine saves to prevent the Koreans increasing their lead. List the entities following this order: first to last Entities:
